### 2026-10-18 – Today, I began working on Merbl Run!

**4h**

Today, I began working on Merbl Run!
I know it's super late to start, but I've been super busy all week.
I also know that my time seems excessive for what I've done today. Thing was, I ran into so many little errors like "Sketch could not be solved" and "Some external references are missing"... Plus this is my first time exploring OnShape and it did take a little time to get accustomed to the software!
Also saw that the work time required was lowered from 10 hours to 6? (not sure if its for all projects or this specific one)!
Not much customization today; I just followed instructions straight from the guide. The video tutorials at the end of the sections were REALLY helpful!
Today, I finished part i and almost ii. Tomorrow, I'm going to work on finishing part ii and finish part iii, film my 5 hour progress reel, gather my images, form my BOM, and submit!
Some issues today (these are notes that I jotted down while I was working today):
- couldn't find dimension tool for a while
- confused betwen 100 mm and 75 mm for the edge of the rectangle
- initially had a hard time moving perspective AND objects around which was pretty confusing
- figuring out how to curve the tracks (line + fillet) method didn't work. TRYING SECOND METHOD NOW. doesn't work
- ultimately I had to try out the video tutorial and both line-circle methods before it worked! is below. though i had a small issue with expanding my circle as the center point from the end of a line; produced 2 dots. i had to zoom in and precisely "merge" them (just overlapped, I believe. if that turns out to be an issue i'll correct that tomorrow):
![Screenshot 2026-10-17 233616](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pwNbc3CZtwBCGJ0ZksWAw7XQQPlAMTId/488ffd1de6664943ad7435231fe6cc0eb79f4ec493562208840bd62243fc05b2.png)
- WAY too late into building: just we can use our own numbers for anything oopsie...
- wasn't letting me change the distance when finalizing my track from 2 circles; wasn't letting me lengthen my middle line, so i had to keep it at around 1.97m. more severe error earlier but i just took a screen shot and it looks like this

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pwNbc3CZtwBCGJ0ZksWAw7XQQPlAMTId/db4dad5f0837da7f5bd958aad1b6478ebef954b04fef25668df1529b057cbbe6.png)

 - had to make my circle smaller after making the s-shape basic design for the tracks
- had to calculate ratio from 23:18 to 21:x for my two circles as all my proportions were smaller including my curves and straight lines for my acutal tracks; ended up setting them to 21 and 16 mm
- noticed that my measurements don't default to mm like in the video tutorials, they default to m. note to self fix that tomorrow if i can!
- circles started coming up as low quality?
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pwNbc3CZtwBCGJ0ZksWAw7XQQPlAMTId/f57e1f0a6033b07bcfd82a92c4c69f99e642f3fa1b9658e08fb85edf90c7e492.png)

Anyways, OnShape is a really cool tool with so many interesting features!! I'm glad Merbl Run gives us the chance to explore this platform. My favorite part is definitely Sweep: the 1d track turning 3d makes my work feel so much more real, almost. Like my work is legit and not just a 1d mockup, and what I'm going to build is 3d and real! I love the look of the 3d objects too! They're so shiny!
This is what I've gotten done today.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pwNbc3CZtwBCGJ0ZksWAw7XQQPlAMTId/283deb6dd6fb40be9f00a1c4289cae37de06daaeabe86713ab799e41902d2e94.png)

See you in tomorrow's entry!
